description: cuCascade provides high-performance GPU and host I/O, memory management, and asynchronous data transfer pipelines, accompanied by benchmark suites and developer automation tools.

components.name: Public Core Library Headers
components.description: Declares public C++ templates, interfaces, and data structures for GPU/host memory management, I/O reactors, data representations, and logging.

components.name: Unified IO Engine
components.description: Provides multi-backend asynchronous I/O contexts, request routing, caching, and protocol engines for local io_uring, REST/S3, and S3RDMA.

components.name: Core IO Primitives
components.description: Defines fundamental I/O structures, memory byte ranges, request queues, and the templated reactor context base class.

components.name: IO Requests and Range Primitives
components.description: Defines basic data structures, grouped asynchronous request coordinators, byte ranges, and operational types for cuCascade I/O operations.

components.name: IO Subsystem Configuration
components.description: Defines top-level configuration options and credentials for the datasource layer, storage backends, and caching policies.

components.name: Templated Reactor Contexts
components.description: Provides templated reactor context drivers and backend placeholder contexts for coordinating asynchronous read pipelines across multiple worker reactors.

components.name: Tiered Concurrent Queues
components.description: Implements multi-producer multi-consumer lock-free queues and priority-tiered blocking queues for reactor dispatching and caching tasks.

components.name: REST Object Store Backend
components.description: Implements RESTful object-store communication, SigV4 signing, S3 object listing, and REST reactor workers.

components.name: IO Ring and Registry
components.description: Provides the base I/O context interface, backend registration mechanisms, and the io_uring asynchronous execution backend.

components.name: TLS Record Protection
components.description: Defines TLS cryptographic primitives, session management, and record encryption and decryption interfaces.

components.name: Tiered Memory Management
components.description: Manages tiered memory allocations, cross-tier memory reservations, NUMA topology discovery, and memory-aware adaptors across device, host, and disk spaces.

components.name: Memory Space and Reservation Management
components.description: Coordinates memory spaces across tiers, managing memory reservations, allocation policies, and host allocators.

components.name: System and Network Topology Discovery
components.description: Discovers hardware layout, NUMA affinity, and network interface queue topology for memory alignment.

components.name: Resource Adaptor and Reservation Configurator
components.description: Wraps device memory resources with per-stream tracking and provides builder interfaces to configure reservation managers.

components.name: Disk Tier Storage and Access Control
components.description: Manages disk storage layouts and limits disk tier access concurrency through reserved arenas.

components.name: Asynchronous Execution Runtime
components.description: Implements thread pools, admission control, scoped execution dispatchers, and semi-future asynchronous task orchestration.

components.name: Futures and Task Dispatching
components.description: Provides semi-future/promise synchronization, scoped task dispatching, and slot-based completion tracking.

components.name: Admission Control and Stream Retirement
components.description: Provides budget-based execution admission control, move-only invocable wrappers, and CUDA stream completion retirement.

components.name: Worker Thread Pool Management
components.description: Implements fixed-size worker thread pools, thread affinity settings, and execution threading configurations.

components.name: Batch Data Representation
components.description: Defines data batch containers, representation converters, and pluggable disk I/O backend repositories for tiered data storage.

components.name: CUDF Data Source Integration
components.description: Bridges cuCascade asynchronous I/O and memory representations into libcudf datasource readers and GPU/host tabular representations.

components.name: CUDA Runtime Utilities
components.description: Provides CUDA stream and event wrappers, asynchronous device copy batches, error handling macros, and NVTX instrumentation.

components.name: Foundation Helper Utilities
components.description: Supplies shared low-level utilities including atomic helpers, scope cleanup guards, and variant visitor overloaded templates.

components.name: Core Runtime Implementation
components.description: Implements cuCascade core runtime logic including I/O reactors, TLS handling, S3 REST interactions, memory allocators, and logging sinks.

components.name: Network and REST Storage IO
components.description: Manages network communication, io_uring asynchronous event loops, TLS encryption, and REST/S3 protocol handling for remote storage.

components.name: REST and S3 Storage Engine
components.description: Implements HTTP protocols, S3 SigV4 authorization, io_uring network transports, and asynchronous REST reactors.

components.name: HTTP Protocol Codec
components.description: Parses HTTP responses and chunked framing, formats request headers, and validates HTTP content ranges.

components.name: REST Reactor Execution Engine
components.description: Schedules REST IO operations, manages reactor placement and threads, and coordinates shared network services.

components.name: Asynchronous Network Transport Engine
components.description: Drives non-blocking socket operations, TLS handshakes, data streaming, and DNS resolution using io_uring.

components.name: S3 Request Signing and Parsing
components.description: Implements AWS SigV4 request authentication, presigned URL generation, and S3 XML listing response parsing.

components.name: TLS Security and Encryption
components.description: Provides OpenSSL session management, AEAD record cryptographic operations, and kernel TLS socket setup.

components.name: OpenSSL Provider and Session Management
components.description: Manages OpenSSL context lifecycles, trust store discovery, client session caching, and TLS handshake sessions.

components.name: Kernel TLS Socket Offload
components.description: Installs socket-level kernel TLS encryption and manages TLS control records and post-handshake rekeying.

components.name: OpenSSL EVP AEAD Adapter
components.description: Provides OpenSSL EVP-based AES-GCM AEAD encryption and decryption cipher implementations.

components.name: TLS Key Schedule Derivation
components.description: Derives TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 traffic keys, IVs, secrets, and key blocks using OpenSSL KDF algorithms.

components.name: TLS Record Layer Decryption
components.description: Parses TLS record framing from ciphertext streams and decrypts record payloads into destination buffers.

components.name: TLS Error and Key Primitives
components.description: Defines core TLS error codes, error categories, and secure wiping for sensitive traffic key material.

components.name: IO Context Dispatch Registry
components.description: Registers and constructs storage backend contexts, provides URI parsing, and drives local io_uring reactors.

components.name: Memory Space and Tier Management
components.description: Controls memory spaces, NUMA topology discovery, pinned host allocations, and reservation-aware memory adaptors across device, host, and disk tiers.

components.name: Memory Space Reservation Management
components.description: Manages tier-specific memory spaces, tracking capacity limits and reservations across GPU, host, and disk tiers.

components.name: Peer DMA Access Verification
components.description: Probes and caches direct peer DMA transfer support across GPU device pairs and manages host memory pool registrations.

components.name: Hardware Topology Discovery
components.description: Discovers network, PCIe, CPU core affinity, and NUMA system topology via sysfs, procfs, NVML, and the CUDA driver API.

components.name: NUMA Pinned Host Allocation
components.description: Provides NUMA-bound page mapping, memory policy binding, and pinned host memory resources.

components.name: GPU cuDF Data Representations
components.description: Provides cuDF integration layers, GPU table representations, and datasource adapters interfacing cudf readers with cascaded I/O backends.

components.name: Disk Storage and IO Pipelines
components.description: Provides disk I/O backends, batch representations, and an extensible registry for asynchronous NVMe and file pipeline operations.

components.name: Execution and Logging Utilities
components.description: Supplies runtime execution utilities including thread naming, CPU affinity, priority scheduling, and core logging capabilities.

components.name: Performance Benchmarking Suite
components.description: Evaluates throughput and latency of data representation conversion, Parquet parsing, and S3 I/O pipelines.

components.name: Development Automation Scripts
components.description: Provides automation scripts to compare benchmark runs and generate API documentation.
